judgement.summary: This is an event-sequence portfolio whose six cards explain repeat recognition and close with recognising the repeat, specifying behavior, and testing it, grounded in Leena’s confirmed concern and working artifacts. Its greatest weakness is that the actual design rationale and verifier checks remain unavailable, limiting how deeply a hiring manager can inspect her engineering decisions.
